text: The SIPROTEC 7UT87 is a modular transformer differential protection relay. We designed it for multi-winding transformers to support up to five sides and safeguard your critical assets.
heading: Why SIPROTEC 7UT87?

text: Protect complex multi-winding transformers and systems with many measuring points like phase shifter, FACTS and converter transformers, arc furnace transformers and HVDC transformers. Our SIPROTEC 7UT87 provides comprehensive main and backup protection with flexible functions supported by DIGSI 5.
heading: Why SIPROTEC 7UT87?

text: Enhance fault detection with up to three differential and five ground fault differential protection functions. Use up to 20 three-phase current and voltage measuring points for extensive monitoring. Its modular hardware allows flexible I/O expansion. Conformal coating supports high availability in tough environments.
heading: Why SIPROTEC 7UT87?
